attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: full_article_publishing_pipeline
steps:
  - id: search_pending_pdfs
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/google-drive/api/files/search"
      query:
        folder: "pending_articles"
        mime_type: "application/pdf"
    output: raw_pdf_list

  - id: validate_pdf_list
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_list
      schema: google_drive_file_list_schema
    output: validated_pdf_list

  - id: loop_each_pdf
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_pdf_list
      steps:
        - id: download_pdf_binary
          op: fetch_api
          params:
            endpoint: "/google-drive/api/files/download"
            file_id: "{{item.file_id}}"
          output: raw_pdf_binary

        - id: sanitize_pdf_binary
          op: validate_schema
          params:
            input: raw_pdf_binary
            schema: pdf_binary_schema
          output: validated_pdf_binary

        - id: send_to_ai_vision
          op: call_webhook
          params:
            url: "/ai-vision/api/extract"
            method: "POST"
            input: validated_pdf_binary
            content_type: "application/pdf"
          output: raw_ai_response

        - id: validate_ai_response
          op: validate_schema
          params:
            input: raw_ai_response
            schema: ai_extraction_response_schema
          output: validated_ai_response

        - id: extract_multiple_flag
          op: extract_field
          params:
            input: validated_ai_response
            field: "es_multiple"
          output: multiple_flag

        - id: check_multiple_articles
          op: apply_rule
          params:
            rule: "multiple_flag == true"
            input_vars:
              multiple_flag: multiple_flag
          output: is_multiple_result

        - id: route_multiple_or_single
          op: route_to_step
          params:
            condition: "is_multiple_result.result == true"
            true_step: extract_reviews_list
            false_step: wrap_single_article

        - id: extract_reviews_list
          op: extract_field
          params:
            input: validated_ai_response
            field: "reviews"
          output: articles_list

        - id: wrap_single_article
          op: transform_json
          params:
            input: validated_ai_response
            mapping:
              articles: ["{{validated_ai_response}}"]
          output: articles_list_single

        - id: merge_article_lists
          op: apply_rule
          params:
            rule: "select non-null articles list from either branch"
            input_vars:
              multi: articles_list
              single: articles_list_single
          output: final_articles_list

        - id: loop_each_article
          op: loop_records
          params:
            input: final_articles_list
            steps:
              - id: normalise_title
                op: transform_json
                params:
                  input: "{{article_item}}"
                  mapping:
                    normalised_title: "strip_accents_lowercase({{article_item.title}})"
                    original: "{{article_item}}"
                output: normalised_article

              - id: fetch_category_spreadsheet
                op: fetch_api
                params:
                  endpoint: "/google-drive/api/spreadsheets/categories"
                output: raw_category_spreadsheet

              - id: validate_category_spreadsheet
                op: validate_schema
                params:
                  input: raw_category_spreadsheet
                  schema: category_spreadsheet_schema
                output: validated_categories

              - id: match_category
                op: filter_records
                params:
                  input: validated_categories
                  condition: "normalised_title CONTAINS record.title_pattern"
                output: matched_categories

              - id: apply_default_category_rule
                op: apply_rule
                params:
                  rule: "if matched_categories is empty, flag for review and use default category"
                  input_vars:
                    matched: matched_categories
                output: category_decision

              - id: flag_no_match_notify
                op: route_to_step
                params:
                  condition: "category_decision.flagged == true"
                  true_step: notify_review_needed
                  false_step: convert_content_to_html

              - id: notify_review_needed
                op: notify_user
                params:
                  input: normalised_article
                  recipient: "editorial_team"
                  message: "Article '{{normalised_article.original.title}}' had no category match - published with default category. Please review."

              - id: convert_content_to_html
                op: transform_json
                params:
                  input: normalised_article
                  mapping:
                    html_body: "convert_plain_to_html({{normalised_article.original.content}}, detect_interview_format=true)"
                    title: "{{normalised_article.original.title}}"
                    category: "{{category_decision.category}}"
                output: html_article

              - id: lookup_cms_metadata
                op: fetch_api
                params:
                  endpoint: "/cms/api/lookup"
                  query:
                    author_name: "{{html_article.title}}"
                    category_name: "{{html_article.category}}"
                output: raw_cms_metadata

              - id: validate_cms_metadata
                op: validate_schema
                params:
                  input: raw_cms_metadata
                  schema: cms_metadata_schema
                output: cms_metadata

              - id: retrieve_csrf_token
                op: fetch_api
                params:
                  endpoint: "/cms/session/token"
                output: raw_csrf_token

              - id: validate_csrf_token
                op: validate_schema
                params:
                  input: raw_csrf_token
                  schema: csrf_token_schema
                output: csrf_token

              - id: authenticate_cms_user
                op: authenticate_user
                params:
                  role: "cms_publisher"
                  csrf_token: "{{csrf_token}}"
                output: cms_auth

              - id: prepare_paragraph_blocks
                op: transform_json
                params:
                  input: html_article
                  mapping:
                    paragraphs: "split_html_to_paragraph_blocks({{html_article.html_body}})"
                    metadata: "{{cms_metadata}}"
                output: paragraph_payloads

              - id: create_paragraph_blocks
                op: write_database
                params:
                  input: paragraph_payloads
                  table: "cms_paragraph_entities"
                  csrf_token: "{{csrf_token}}"
                output: created_paragraphs

              - id: retry_paragraph_creation
                op: retry_step
                params:
                  step_id: create_paragraph_blocks
                  max_retries: 3
                  backoff: "exponential"

              - id: prepare_article_node
                op: transform_json
                params:
                  input: html_article
                  mapping:
                    title: "{{html_article.title}}"
                    author_id: "{{cms_metadata.author_id}}"
                    category_uuid: "{{cms_metadata.category_uuid}}"
                    magazine_uuid: "{{cms_metadata.magazine_uuid}}"
                    paragraph_refs: "{{created_paragraphs.ids}}"
                    category_flag: "{{category_decision.flagged}}"
                output: article_node_payload

              - id: create_article_node
                op: write_database
                params:
                  input: article_node_payload
                  table: "cms_article_nodes"
                  csrf_token: "{{csrf_token}}"
                output: published_article

              - id: retry_article_creation
                op: retry_step
                params:
                  step_id: create_article_node
                  max_retries: 3
                  backoff: "exponential"
